name: Meter
description: One measured value against a capacity or target, such as storage or a quota, with optional status thresholds shown as tone, label and track marks.

props.label: string (what is measured; the meter's accessible name)
props.format: (value: number) => string (formats the value and the maximum; default the locale number format)
props.thresholds: { at: number; tone: success | warning | danger; label: string }[] (the highest one reached sets the tone and shows its label)

contract.usage: Import { Meter } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar/charts. Use it for a measured amount against a capacity or target: storage, seats, a quota or a budget. Give every threshold a label such as "Near limit"; the label is shown and read, so the status never depends on colour. For the progress of a task, use ProgressBar.
contract.avoid: Do not use it for task progress, colour it with a series or raw colour, rely on the tone without a threshold label, copy implementations or override central colours.
contract.accessibility: Renders role=meter named by label, with a value text such as "82 GB of 100 GB, Near limit". Verify the threshold labels read well after the value.
